title: Physics-informed machine learning for reconstruction of dynamical systems with invariant measure score matching
authors: Yongsheng Chen, Suddhasattwa Das, Wei Guo et al.
blob: physics-informed machine learning for reconstruction of dynamical systems with invariant measure score matching in this paper, we develop a novel mesh-free framework, termed physics-informed neural networks with invariant measure score matching (pinn-imsm), for reconstructing dynamical systems from unlabeled point-cloud data that capture the system's invariant measure. the invariant density satisfies the steady-state fokker-planck (fp) equation. we reformulate this equation in terms of its score function (the gradient of the log-density), which is estimated directly from data via denoising score matching, 该方法用于重建动力系统，而非解决生物力学或植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。 no fea surrogate modeling, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no application to implant or biomechanics design. 从无标签点云数据重建动力系统，避免显式密度估计。 结合去噪分数匹配和物理信息神经网络，求解稳态fokker-planck方程。 在多个动力系统（包括混沌系统）中准确重建不变测度和动力学行为。 在van der pol振荡器、lorenz系统等数值基准上验证。 physics-informed neural networks dynamical systems score matching fokker-planck equation mesh-free physics-informed neural networks 物理信息神经网络 score matching 分数匹配 invariant measure 不变测度 fokker-planck equation 福克-普朗克方程 dynamical system reconstruction 动力系统重建 mesh-free method 无网格方法 augmented lagrangian 增广拉格朗日 curse of dimensionality 维度灾难 yongsheng chen, suddhasattwa das, wei guo, xinghui zhong arxiv preprint

title: Conformal Prediction for Early Stopping in Mixed Integer Optimization
authors: Stefan Clarke, Bartolomeo Stellato
blob: conformal prediction for early stopping in mixed integer optimization mixed-integer optimization solvers often find optimal solutions early in the search, yet spend the majority of computation time proving optimality. we exploit this by learning when to terminate solvers early on distributions of similar problem instances. our method trains a neural network to estimate the true optimality gap from the solver state, then uses conformal prediction to calibrate a stopping threshold with rigorous probabilistic guarantees on solution quality. on five problem families f 与有限元代理建模方向无关，讨论混合整数优化求解器早期停止。 the paper focuses on early stopping in mixed-integer optimization solvers, not on surrogate modeling for expensive fea simulations or biomechanical design. 混合整数优化求解器常耗时证明最优性，需提前停止。 用神经网络估计最优间隙，结合共形预测校准停止阈值。 在五个问题族上求解时间减少60%以上，保证0.1%最优解。 在分布miplib基准上验证概率保证。 conformal prediction mixed-integer optimization early stopping conformal prediction 共形预测 mixed-integer optimization 混合整数优化 early stopping 提前停止 optimality gap 最优间隙 stefan clarke, bartolomeo stellato arxiv preprint

blob: iterative data-consistent inversion with multiple push-forward constraints a foundational challenge in uncertainty quantification involves estimating a probability measure on the space of uncertain parameters such that its push-forward through a computational model matches an observed probability measure on the output data associated with quantities of interest (qoi). when multiple, distinct sets of observational data are available, the desired parameter measure should simultaneously satisfy multiple push-forward constraints associated with various subsets of the qoi.  该论文提出了一种处理多约束不确定性问题的方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的多目标优化与不确定性量化。 this paper does not address fea surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on measure-theoretic inversion with multiple push-forward constraints. 解决多观测数据下参数分布需同时满足多个推前约束的挑战。 提出迭代数据一致性反演框架，通过最小化累积f-散度收敛到多约束解。 理论证明最优性，数值算例验证高维pde参数空间的有效性。 通过高维pde数值算例验证方法收敛性与鲁棒性。 uncertainty quantification data-consistent inversion multiple constraints f-divergence i-projection uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 data-consistent inversion 数据一致性反演 push-forward constraint 推前约束 f-divergence f-散度 i-projection i-投影 measure-theoretic 测度论 high-dimensional parameter space 高维参数空间 partial differential equations 偏微分方程 tianyi jiang, troy butler, timothy wildey, tim kutta, haonan wang arxiv preprint

title: 4CPS-053 Reducing oxycodone prescription and use in orthopaedic patients after hip or knee arthroplasty: a pre-post intervention study
authors: M Phaff, R Geuze, Barbara Maat
blob:
4cps-053 reducing oxycodone prescription and use in orthopaedic patients after hip or knee arthroplasty: a pre-post intervention study

background and importance

surgical procedures such as total knee arthroplasty (tka) and total hip arthroplasty (tha) are associated with risks of long-term opioid use. implementing interventions that effectively reduce these risks remains a challenge.

aim and objectives

to assess the effect of a multifaceted intervention at patient-, nurse- and prescriber-level on postoperative prescribing and use of oxycodone after discharge in tka and tha patients.

blob: morphoflow: sparse-supervised generative shape modeling with adaptive latent relevance statistical shape modeling (ssm) is central to population level analysis of anatomical variability, yet most existing approaches rely on densely annotated segmentations and fixed latent representations. these requirements limit scalability and reduce flexibility when modeling complex anatomical variation. we introduce morphoflow, a sparse supervised generative shape modeling framework that learns compact probabilistic shape representations directly from sparse surface annotations. morphoflow int 该论文提出的稀疏监督生成形状建模方法可用于生物力学有限元分析中的几何参数化与不确定性量化，但未涉及力学仿真或植入物设计。 this paper focuses on statistical shape modeling and generative shape synthesis, but does not address finite element simulation, surrogate modeling, or implant biomechanics. 现有统计形状模型依赖密集标注和固定潜空间，缺乏灵活性和可扩展性。 提出morphoflow框架，结合神经隐式表示、自解码器和自回归归一化流，学习稀疏监督下的概率形状模型。 在腰椎和股骨数据集上实现高精度重建，并恢复与群体趋势一致的解剖变异模式。 在公开腰椎和股骨数据集上进行数值基准验证。 statistical shape modeling generative model neural implicit representation normalizing flows uncertainty quantification statistical shape modeling 统计形状建模 neural implicit representation 神经隐式表示 autodecoder 自解码器 normalizing flows 归一化流 sparse supervision 稀疏监督 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 latent space 潜空间 anatomical variability 解剖变异 mokshagna sai teja karanam, tushar kataria, shireen elhabian arxiv preprint

title: SCNO: Spiking Compositional Neural Operator -- Towards a Neuromorphic Foundation Model for Nuclear PDE Solving
authors: Samrendra Roy, Souvik Chakraborty, Rizwan-uddin et al.
blob: scno: spiking compositional neural operator -- towards a neuromorphic foundation model for nuclear pde solving neural operators have emerged as powerful surrogates for partial differential equation (pde) solvers, yet they are typically trained as monolithic models for individual pdes, require energy-intensive gpu hardware, and must be retrained from scratch when new physics emerge. we introduce the spiking compositional neural operator (scno), a modular architecture combining spiking and conventional components that addresses all three limitations. scno maintains a library of small spiking neural operato 该论文提出了一种模块化、可组合的脉冲神经算子，用于求解偏微分方程，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物力学应用。 this paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or any biomedical finite element analysis; it focuses on nuclear pdes and general coupled pde systems. 现有神经算子模型庞大、能耗高且无法增量扩展，需要一种模块化、低能耗的替代方案。 提出scno，由多个脉冲神经算子块组成库，通过轻量聚合器组合求解耦合pde。 在五个耦合pde中四个取得最低误差，参数仅95k，优于传统deeponet。 在八个pde族（含五组耦合系统）上进行数值基准测试。 neural operator spiking neural network compositional model pde surrogate modular architecture neural operator 神经算子 spiking neural network 脉冲神经网络 compositional model 组合模型 partial differential equation 偏微分方程 modular architecture 模块化架构 surrogate model 代理模型 coupled pde 耦合偏微分方程 zero-forgetting expansion 零遗忘扩展 samrendra roy, souvik chakraborty, rizwan-uddin, syed bahauddin alam arxiv preprint

title: VLM Judges Can Rank but Cannot Score: Task-Dependent Uncertainty in Multimodal Evaluation
authors: Divake Kumar, Sina Tayebati, Devashri Naik et al.
blob: vlm judges can rank but cannot score: task-dependent uncertainty in multimodal evaluation vision-language models (vlms) are increasingly used as automated judges for multimodal systems, yet their scores provide no indication of reliability. we study this problem through conformal prediction, a distribution-free framework that converts a judge's point score into a calibrated prediction interval using only score-token log-probabilities, with no retraining. we present the first systematic analysis of conformal prediction for vlm-as-a-judge across 3 judges and 14 visual task categories.  该论文研究vlm评估中的不确定性量化，与fea代理建模或生物力学设计无直接关联。 this paper does not address fea surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any structural/mechanical simulation; it focuses on uncertainty in vlm-based evaluation tasks. vlm评分缺乏可靠性指示，需量化评估不确定性。 使用共形预测将点分数转换为校准预测区间，无需重新训练。 评估不确定性高度依赖任务类型，并发现排名-评分解耦现象。 在3个评判者和14个视觉任务类别上系统分析。 conformal prediction uncertainty quantification vision-language model evaluation conformal prediction 共形预测 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 vision-language model 视觉语言模型 automated judge 自动评判者 prediction interval 预测区间 ranking-scoring decoupling 排名-评分解耦 divake kumar, sina tayebati, devashri naik, ranganath krishnan, amit ranjan trivedi arxiv preprint

authors: Fabio Pereira dos Santos, Julio de Castro Vargas Fernandes, Adriano Mauricio de Almeida Cortes
blob: shearlet neural operators for anisotropic-shock-dominated and multi-scale parametric partial differential equations neural operators have emerged as powerful data-driven surrogates for learning solution operators of parametric partial differential equations (pdes). however, widely used fourier neural operators (fnos) rely on global fourier representations, which can be inefficient for resolving anisotropic structures, sharp gradients, and spatially localized discontinuities that arise in shock-dominated and multiscale regimes. to address these limitations, we introduce the shearlet neural operator (sno), a ne 该论文提出的剪切波神经算子（sno）在解决各向异性和间断主导的pde问题上优于fno，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中处理应力集中等特征。 this paper does not include any biomedical or implant-related fea validation, nor does it address constraint handling or uncertainty quantification. 现有傅里叶神经算子难以有效处理各向异性和间断特征。 提出剪切波神经算子，用剪切波变换替代傅里叶变换以增强方向性和局部性。 在七个基准pde族上，sno在精度和特征保真度上一致优于fno。 通过七个基准pde族（包括各向异性对流、扩散、非线性守恒律等）进行数值验证。 neural operator shearlet anisotropic pde shock-dominated multiscale surrogate modeling neural operator 神经算子 shearlet transform 剪切波变换 fourier neural operator 傅里叶神经算子 anisotropic pde 各向异性偏微分方程 shock-dominated 激波主导 multiscale 多尺度 surrogate modeling 代理建模 parametric pde 参数化偏微分方程 fabio pereira dos santos, julio de castro vargas fernandes, adriano mauricio de almeida cortes arxiv preprint

blob: when attention beats fourier: multi-scale transformers for pde solving on irregular domains we study the problem of \emph{architecture selection} for deep learning models trained to solve partial differential equations (pdes), asking when transformer-based architectures with learned attention outperform fourier-domain neural operators. we introduce the \textbf{multi-scale attention transformer} (\msat{}), a deep learning architecture that encodes spatiotemporal solution histories as token sequences and trains end-to-end via a composite supervised objective with optional physics-informe 该论文提出的多尺度注意力transformer在求解不规则域上的pde时表现出色，其架构选择原则和物理正则化权衡可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。 the paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address constrained optimization or expensive simulation sampling efficiency. 探究何种深度学习架构最适合求解偏微分方程，尤其是复杂几何域上的问题。 提出多尺度注意力transformer（msat），将时空解历史编码为token序列，结合监督损失和物理正则化进行端到端训练。 在复杂几何基准上msat相对fno提升3.7倍精度，且推理速度远快于mamba-no。 在pinnacle套件的五个基准问题上与九种基线方法进行公平对比验证。 transformer pde solving neural operator irregular domain multi-scale attention physics-informed regularization architecture selection multi-scale attention 多尺度注意力 transformer transformer neural operator 神经算子 partial differential equation 偏微分方程 irregular domain 不规则域 physics-informed regularization 物理信息正则化 architecture selection 架构选择 inductive bias 归纳偏置 brandon yee, pairie koh, jack rodriguez, mihir tekal arxiv preprint

blob: stabilized neural hamilton--jacobi--bellman solvers: error analysis and applications in model-based reinforcement learning physics-informed neural solvers offer a promising route to model-based reinforcement learning in continuous time, where optimal feedback synthesis is governed by hamilton--jacobi--bellman (hjb) equations. practical implementations often occupy a regime that is neither a classical grid method nor a continuous-pde pinn: the value function is represented by a neural network, finite-difference hjb policy-evaluation operators are evaluated by network queries at shifted points, and residuals are minim 该论文关注强化学习中的hjb方程求解，与生物力学有限元代理建模无直接关联。 this paper focuses on neural hjb solvers for model-based reinforcement learning, not on surrogate modeling for expensive finite element simulations, and lacks any biomedical or implant design context. 为连续时间强化学习中的hjb方程提供稳定的神经求解器误差理论。 结合有限差分策略评估与随机连续配置点的神经网络表示，推导稳定性估计。 证明了策略评估步骤的l2稳定性，并在多个控制基准上验证了误差趋势。 通过lqr、allen-cahn、摆、hopper和3d四旋翼等数值基准验证。 hamilton-jacobi-bellman physics-informed neural networks reinforcement learning error analysis optimal control hamilton-jacobi-bellman equation 哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程 physics-informed neural network 物理信息神经网络 model-based reinforcement learning 基于模型的强化学习 finite difference 有限差分 error analysis 误差分析 optimal control 最优控制 minseok kim, yeongjong kim, namkyeong cho, yeoneung kim arxiv preprint

authors: Ryoichiro Agata, Tomohisa Okazaki

blob: safe exploration for nonlinear processes using online gaussian process learning this paper proposes a safe data-driven control framework for nonlinear systems with partially known dynamics. the method ensures stability and constraint satisfaction during online learning, assuming only a stabilizable linear approximation of the process is available. unmodeled nonlinear dynamics are captured by a gaussian process residual learned in real time. safety is enforced through a probabilistic control-invariant set derived from lyapunov theory, guaranteeing high-probability stability. 该论文关注非线性系统的安全控制，而非生物力学或植入物设计的代理建模。 this paper does not address fea surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or design optimization under constraints; it focuses on safe control of nonlinear dynamical systems with gaussian processes. 在部分已知非线性系统中实现安全的数据驱动控制。 利用在线高斯过程学习未建模动态，结合李雅普诺夫理论构建概率安全不变集。 安全集扩大约30%，高斯过程均方根误差从1.11降至0.03。 数值仿真验证了安全探索和不确定性降低。 safe exploration gaussian process nonlinear control lyapunov theory online learning safe exploration 安全探索 gaussian process 高斯过程 nonlinear control 非线性控制 lyapunov theory 李雅普诺夫理论 online learning 在线学习 probabilistic safety 概率安全 control-invariant set 控制不变集 quadratic program 二次规划 stefano tonini, soroush rastegarpour, hamid reza feyzmahdavian, nicola bastianello, karl henrik johansson arxiv preprint

blob: foundations of reliable inference: reliability-efficiency co-design reliable inference requires that artificial intelligence (ai) models provide trustworthy uncertainty estimates, not merely accurate predictions. recent advances in bayesian learning have made significant progress toward this goal, and growing concerns about computational overhead have jointly shifted the design criterion from reliability alone to the co-design of reliability and efficiency, i.e., reducing computational overhead while preserving trustworthy uncertainty quantification. this thesis 该论文关注贝叶斯推理的可靠性与效率协同设计，未涉及有限元代理建模或生物力学应用。 no fea surrogate modeling, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization. 在保持可靠不确定性量化的同时降低计算开销。 提出可靠性与效率协同设计的统一框架。 探讨高效进行可靠推理的可能性。 无实验验证，为理论框架。 bayesian inference uncertainty quantification efficiency reliability reliable inference 可靠推理 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 bayesian learning 贝叶斯学习 computational overhead 计算开销 co-design 协同设计 jiayi huang arxiv preprint

title: bde: A Python Package for Bayesian Deep Ensembles via MILE
authors: Vyron Arvanitis, Angelos Aslanidis, Emanuel Sommer et al.
blob: bde: a python package for bayesian deep ensembles via mile bde is a user-friendly python package for bayesian deep ensembles with a particular focus on tabular data. built on an efficient jax implementation of the sampling-based inference method microcanonical langevin ensembles (mile), it provides scikit-learn compatible estimators for fast training, efficient markov chain monte carlo sampling, and uncertainty quantification in both regression and classification tasks. 该论文提供了一个用于贝叶斯深度集成的python包，但未涉及有限元代理建模或生物力学设计。 this paper focuses on a general-purpose bayesian deep ensemble package for tabular data, with no application to fea surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanical implant design. 提供易用的贝叶斯深度集成工具包，支持不确定性量化。 基于jax实现微正则朗之万集成采样，兼容scikit-learn接口。 实现了高效的mcmc采样和不确定性量化，适用于回归和分类。 未提供实验验证，仅描述软件功能。 bayesian deep ensemble uncertainty quantification python package tabular data bayesian deep ensemble 贝叶斯深度集成 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 mcmc sampling 马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样 tabular data 表格数据 jax jax框架 vyron arvanitis, angelos aslanidis, emanuel sommer, david rügamer arxiv preprint

background

there has been a shift in the demographics of patients undergoing elective lower extremity joint arthroplasties in recent years. this study aimed to assess whether research has kept pace with changing demographics through analyzing inclusion and exclusion criteria of randomized controlled trials (rcts) relevant to total hip arthroplasties (thas).
